name: gizza-ai/spritesheet-slice
summary: Slice a grid sprite sheet into individual frame PNGs (ZIP).

tool.description: Slice a grid sprite sheet into individual frames, returned bundled in a ZIP. Describe the grid either by columns + rows, or by tile_width + tile_height (fixed-size tiles); margin (outer border) and spacing (gap between frames) default to 0. Set skip_empty to drop fully-transparent frames, max_frames to cap how many are written, format to choose the per-frame encoding (png/jpeg/webp/bmp), and prefix to name them. Frames are named <prefix>_000.<ext>, <prefix>_001.<ext>, … (prefix defaults to frame) in row-major order. Provide the sheet as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

columns.description: Number of columns in the grid. Pair with rows (grid mode).

rows.description: Number of rows in the grid. Pair with columns (grid mode).

tile_width.description: Frame width in pixels. Pair with tile_height (tile-size mode).

tile_height.description: Frame height in pixels. Pair with tile_width (tile-size mode).

margin.description: Border in pixels around all four edges of the sheet.

spacing.description: Gap in pixels between adjacent frames.

skip_empty.description: Drop frames that are fully transparent (every pixel alpha 0).

format.description: Per-frame image format. png/webp/bmp keep alpha; jpeg is opaque.

prefix.description: Filename base for each frame, e.g. frame -> frame_000.png.

max_frames.description: Stop after writing this many frames (default: all cells).
